questions.question: What is the capital of Japan?

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Slave Dynasty in India?
questions.explanation: Qutub-ud-din Aibak founded the Mamluk (Slave) Dynasty in 1206.

hi.question: भारत में गुलाम वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
